## Problem and outcome

C198 adopted the finite static-tray mapping but had no implementation. This PR adds its explicitly selected experimental prototype and retains the complete failed first native qualification attempt. The prototype remains **unqualified**, no tray is admitted, and this PR makes no release claim.

## Changes

- Add OntoKin and bounded direct-Python frontends using the unchanged construction compiler, a shared Blender worker, an independent GLB reader, receiving comparison, and bounded transaction coordination.
- Freeze the actual executable/dependency closure and independent pre-execution approval.
- Retain preparation controls, unsuccessful attempts, the single native execution, logs and diagnostic scene, independent reviews, and exact handoff tools.
- Update current STATUS/navigation under verified lease `c199-tray-9d641f68`. Historical runtime, tests, contracts, numerical gates and hosted workflows are unchanged.

## Actual qualification result

N01/Q01/OntoKin started once and was rejected when the pinned exporter raised `KeyError: 'loglevel'`. Stderr also records an inactive action-filter callback accessing an absent scene property. There are **zero accepted transactions, GLB deliveries, receiving jobs or checks of actual deliveries**. N02–N12 never started. There was no retry or post-failure settings change.

C200 must review a pinned-exporter compatibility repair, freeze new inputs and approve a new bounded protocol. The stopped C199 schedule cannot resume.

## Verification and integration scope

- Final integrated CPU cohort: 92 methods passed; the earlier import-failing run remains retained.
- Reviewed L-R1 lifecycle cohort: 8 cases and 131 independent checks passed; original attempts remain retained.
- Three synthetic format-reader controls passed.
- Existing compiler: 57 methods passed; core conformance: 43 cases / 694 assertions passed.
- Independent recorded native result review: 38 checks passed, approving only an incomplete experimental increment under OK-ENG-009.
- Final candidate review: 10 checks passed, including all 280 locked repository inputs and unchanged approval.
- Documentation preservation/navigation: passed, 29 sources, no failures.

The legacy full regression remains **FAILED**, with 4,239 distinct passing methods and 13 torque-read methods NOT RUN after the unchanged 30,000 ms setup failure. It was not rerun or relabeled. Actual-main checks and final package verification follow the merge.

Exact shared tree: `f25b1eaa0a3d4d87302582d06f9b1da6c563e4d5`

Git data publication creates a distinct remote commit; its full tree is identical to the reviewed local candidate. The original local history is retained in the handoff bundle. Refs #134; the qualification work remains open.
